# NorthWake Marine — AI Crawler Reference

NorthWake Marine is a professional marine services company based in Jacksonville, Florida, serving the St. Johns River corridor and Northeast Florida coastline.

## Company

- Name: NorthWake Marine
- Location: Jacksonville, FL
- Phone: (904) 606-5454
- Email: info@northwakemarine.com
- Website: https://www.northwakemarine.com
- Founded: 2025
- Service model: Mobile — we come to your dock, marina slip, or dry storage

## Services

### Mechanical Services (Yamaha Certified)

- Outboard Engine Service: 100-hour and 300-hour scheduled maintenance, engine oil and filter changes, gear lube service, spark plug replacement, fuel filter service, and impeller inspection. Yamaha-certified mechanic on staff. All outboard brands welcome.
- Outboard Diagnostics & Repair: Engine troubleshooting and repair for overheating, no-start conditions, trim and tilt issues, and propeller damage. All major brands serviced.

### Detailing & Washing

- Maintenance Wash: Top-to-waterline foam bath, chamois dry, glass and non-skid wipe-down, salt removal, rubber trim wipe, and condition check.
- Full Detail: Clay bar, multi-stage compound and polish, marine sealant, stainless polishing, deck scrub, interior cleaning, optional engine bay.
- Gel Coat Restoration: Multi-stage oxidation removal and hull restoration.
- Vinyl & Upholstery Conditioning: UV-protective cleaning and conditioning for seats and cushions.
- Teak Cleaning & Brightening: Two-part teak clean and brightener application.
- Stainless Polish: Corrosion removal and marine-grade protectant.
- Water Spot & Mineral Deposit Removal: Marine-safe removers for glass, stainless, and paint.
- Interior Cleaning & Cabin Detailing: Full interior vacuum, surface wipe-down, teak conditioning, odor elimination.
- Canvas Cleaning & Treatment: Mold and mildew removal, UV and water-repellent treatment.
- Engine Bay & Bilge Cleaning: Marine-safe degreaser, engine bay scrub, bilge cleaning.
- One-Off Washes: Single-visit exterior wash, no maintenance plan required.
- Wax Application: Polymer or carnauba marine wax, 3-6 month protection.

### Protection

- Ceramic Coating: Professional 9H nano-ceramic coating, up to 5 years UV and salt protection, infrared cure, transferable warranty.

### Vessel Management & Transport

- Yacht Management: End-to-end concierge management including crew sourcing, provisioning, compliance, haul-out scheduling, and voyage planning.
- Marine Transport: Licensed vessel transport, local and statewide Florida.
- Captain & Crew Services: USCG-licensed captains and day-rate crew for charters, deliveries, and vessel relocations.
- Custom Requests: Pre-sale prep, parts sourcing, insurance inspections, and any combination of services.

## Service Area

Jacksonville, Mandarin, Ortega, Avondale, San Marco, Southside, Fort Caroline, Palm Valley, Fruit Cove, Jacksonville Beach, Atlantic Beach, Neptune Beach, Ponte Vedra, Ponte Vedra Beach, Mayport, Orange Park, Green Cove Springs, St. Augustine, Amelia Island, Fernandina Beach, Palm Coast, St. Johns

Key waterways: St. Johns River, Ortega River, Intracoastal Waterway, Matanzas River, Amelia River, Nassau Sound

## Certifications

- Yamaha-certified outboard mechanic on staff
- USCG-licensed captains

## About

NorthWake Marine was founded in Jacksonville in 2025 with the goal of delivering world-class marine service without the wait list or the distance. Every job is handled by our own team — no franchises, no subcontractors — using professional-grade products with photo documentation on every visit.
